articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Yegor Gilyov)

Ambient animations are the middle ground — subtle, slow-moving details that add atmosphere without stealing the show. In this article, web design pioneer Andy Clarke introduces the concept of ambient animations and explains how to implement them.
articles.title: Ambient Animations In Web Design: Principles And Implementation (Part 1)

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Victor Yocco)

Here are practical methods and strategies for designing more trustworthy and ethical AI systems.
articles.title: The Psychology Of Trust In AI: A Guide To Measuring And Designing For User Confidence
